meta.name: ❓ Tailliuir Studio FAQ ❓
meta.description:
🧵 Tailliuir Studio FAQ 🧵

Welcome! Here are answers to the most common questions.

❓ Do I need to install anything?

No. Everything is already set up for you. Just open Tailliuir Studio and start watching.

❓ How do I watch something?

Choose a film or TV show, select a stream option, and press play.

❓ What do the thumbs mean?

👍👍 2 Thumbs: Highest quality. Usually 1440p or 4K. Best for 4K TVs.

👍 1 Thumb: 720p to 1080p. Best choice for most TVs and devices.

👎 Thumb Down: Below 720p. Only use if nothing else is available.

❓ Which one should I choose?

If you are unsure, choose 👍.

Only choose 👍👍 if your TV or device supports 4K.

❓ Why are there no thumbs showing?

If a film or TV show has no 👍 or 👍👍 options, there may be a temporary problem finding available choices. Check the 'No Thumbs Showing?' QR code for updates.

❓ Why won't my video start?

If you press a 👍 option and it doesn't play, keeps loading, or stops, check the 'Thumbs Won't Play?' QR code.

❓ Why does my video keep buffering?

Try another 👍 option first. If everything is buffering, there may be a temporary service issue.

❓ The app won't open or looks empty?

Check the 'App Not Working?' QR code to see if there is a known problem.

❓ My TV isn't 4K. What should I use?

Use 👍 options. They are designed for most TVs, phones and tablets.

❓ My TV is 4K. What should I use?

You can use 👍👍 options for the best picture quality, as long as your internet connection and device support it.

❓ What are Backup options?

If you see Backup 1, Backup 2, Backup 3 and so on, these are alternative options used when the main choices are unavailable.

Backup options do not use the thumb system, so choose the highest quality your device can handle.

❓ Something is still wrong. What do I do?

1️⃣ Check the matching QR code for the problem.

2️⃣ Restart the app.

3️⃣ Try again later if there is an outage.

4️⃣ If you still need help, use the Support QR code.

❤️ Enjoy Tailliuir Studio! 🍿
